description: Ground-truth manifest of planted defects, decoys, orphans, and phantom routes in target-app.

defects.summary: Dashboard catch handler never sets isLoading(false), pinning the screen in a permanent skeleton on API failure and making the error banner unreachable.
Unrouted first-run wizard (switched via currentStep) asks a first-time user for internal schema version and priority.
Survey promises results unlock only at >=3 respondents, but ResultsScreen unlocks at completedCount >= 1, exposing the first respondent's private answers as the company average.
Invitations table renders each named participant's individualScore and leaks their raw surveyHash bearer link in the DOM.
startUpgrade hardcodes plan: 'business' regardless of selectedTier, making the highlighted Pro tier impossible to purchase.
Invoices empty state is a bare 'No invoices' string with no explanation of when invoices appear or next action.
attachMembersToCampaign queries members by id without filtering tenant_id = currentUser.tenantId, allowing cross-tenant member attachment.
Unbounded 2N sequential queries per memberId with no array cap or deduplication.

traps.expectedBehavior: Listed in src/router.js:9, but file does not exist on disk. Must be verified missing via phantom:true, never graded with hallucinated findings and never silently skipped.
Exists on disk but has 0 importers across the repo. Should be identified as unreachable dead code and removed after appraisal rather than generating cosmetic UI tickets.
sql tagged template looks like string interpolation at call site but compiles parameterized $1..$n bindings. Must NOT survive as an open SQL injection finding.
